findings.message: Changing the loop bound from i < start+len(pageRows) to i <= start+len(pageRows) adds one extra iteration. The final index rows[start+len(pageRows)] is out of range when the page ends at the end of rows (and otherwise reads/prints an unintended row), causing a slice-out-of-range panic or incorrect output.
findings.suggestion: Revert to i < start+len(pageRows) (or iterate over pageRows directly with index offset).
